tools.name: get_space_jobs_market
tools.description: The space industry roles open now, the ones first posted in the last 7 days and the weekly rate of new postings, broken down by kind of work, US state and employer (each employer with the slug the other tools take).

tools.name: get_space_jobs_by_state
tools.description: Without a state, the open space roles and employers of every US state. Given a state, its roles by kind of work, the salaries they post, the cities and employers with the most roles and its newest roles. Given a state and a kind of work, the same for that work there (propulsion roles in Texas, say).

tools.name: get_space_employer
tools.description: A single employer (or AI-training program or job board): what it does, where it hires, its roles open now by kind of work, the salaries they post, its newest and best-paid roles, with links to its page and to each open role.

tools.name: check_employer_visa_record
tools.description: Looks up a US employer by name in the US Labor Department's certified green card (PERM) and H-1B applications for healthcare jobs: how many it had certified, for which jobs, the hourly wage it offered and where. Use it when someone asks whether an employer sponsors visas or has a job offer from one.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_space_jobs_pay, get_space_jobs_by_state, list_space_employers, get_space_employer · Private data: check_employer_visa_record · Public sink: get_space_jobs_pay, get_space_jobs_by_state, get_space_employer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_space_jobs_pay, get_space_jobs_by_state, list_space_employers, get_space_employer · Private data: check_employer_visa_record · Public sink: get_space_jobs_pay, get_space_jobs_by_state, get_space_employer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_space_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
